items.text: For the 2027 second-year class, what is the incremental cost per additional student passing all examination-skills stations at the first attempt when four of eight faculty sessions are replaced by calibrated near-peer sessions, compared with eight faculty sessions?
items.intervention: Four near-peer and four faculty-led sessions, with tutor calibration
items.outcome: First-attempt pass on all examination-skills stations; teaching cost per student
items.setting: One medical school clinical skills centre

finer: Feasible with existing assessment and cost data and allocation by timetable; interesting to the dean; novel because economic evidence is sparse; ethical with de-identified data; relevant because it decides next year's timetable.
summary: One PICO question pairing effect and cost.
